schema.title:
Public stock ticker parameter. Clients send provider-style symbols such as
`AAPL`, `BRK.B`, `BRK-B`, or `0700.HK`. Parsing validates the corresponding
stock [`CustodyAsset`] exists. Bare tickers are US listings. HK listings
keep their `.HK` suffix throughout because FMP addresses them that way and
Massive does not carry them.
